description: This PHP source file defines the OA_Dal_Statistics_Advertiser class, which provides methods to retrieve various advertising statistics (daily, hourly, by campaign, banner, publisher, zone) for a specific advertiser from the database.

classes.name: OA_Dal_Statistics_Advertiser
classes.description: Data Abstraction Layer class for retrieving advertiser statistics, extending OA_Dal_Statistics.

methods.name: getAdvertiserDailyStatistics
methods.description: Returns daily aggregated statistics (requests, impressions, clicks, revenue) for a given advertiser within a date range, broken down by day and hour.

methods.name: getAdvertiserHourlyStatistics
methods.description: Returns hourly detailed statistics for a given advertiser within a date range, broken down by day and hour.

methods.name: getAdvertiserCampaignStatistics
methods.description: Returns statistics grouped by campaign for a given advertiser within a date range.

methods.name: getAdvertiserBannerStatistics
methods.description: Returns statistics grouped by banner for a given advertiser within a date range.

methods.name: getAdvertiserPublisherStatistics
methods.description: Returns statistics grouped by publisher (affiliate) for a given advertiser within a date range.

methods.name: getAdvertiserZoneStatistics
methods.description: Returns statistics grouped by zone for a given advertiser within a date range.
